name: Fimbrethil
last_seen_place: gardens east of the Anduin (now the Brown Lands)
notes: Fangorn's own. He has walked to the Brown Lands and found them empty. Fair hair of the colour of ripe corn, cheeks red as apple. Liked orchards; liked order.

name: (the Entwives)
notes: The gardens were burned in the wars of the Enemy. No bodies, no word. Men of the Brown Lands later remembered them as teachers of tilling.

name: (Entings)
notes: No Entings since the Entwives went. Filed so the case is not forgotten, not because there is anyone to find.

name: (unknown)
also_called: a tree-man, big as an elm
notes: Walking, seven yards to a stride. Laughed at in the inn. Not laughed at here. See sightings.log and ../treebeard/issues/0005.
